title: no photo in 12h while the render request was refused 11x
evidence: photos_12h=0 refusals_12h=11 holder=none; free=18.5GiB vs reservation 21GiB; outside-scheduler holders: 2857312 labeler_spa.py 4.5GiB -- renders need a near-empty card (measured peak 23.2 of 24.0GiB); card 0% busy over 10s (holder resident but idle)

notes.note: 2026-09-21 04:35Z ops-triage: ROOT CAUSE identified and attributed (probe fix in this run's commit). The refusal is no longer a foreign JOB: the 4090 is scheduler-idle with our entry at the FIFO head and poll refuses vram_insufficient because free=18.5GiB is under our 21GiB reservation. The difference is held OUTSIDE the scheduler by the user-managed BT-Net labeler (pid 2857312 labeler_spa.py, 4.5GiB) plus the display session. ComfyUI's own measured peak on this card is 23.2GiB (log/comfyui_telemetry.jsonl, 372 samples of job comfyui-1789826497-1334030, max vram_used 23743MiB), so a render needs a near-empty card: the labeler and flux renders are mutually exclusive. Not fixable in-repo without measurement: lowering the reservation to fit would claim a card ComfyUI does not fit on (harness VRAM=21 says do not lower it to fit), and measuring a lower-VRAM flux config needs the card the co-tenant holds = blocked-on-slot. Impact today is LOW (19 queued, ~5d runway); it turns CRITICAL at about 2026-09-21 16:00 EDT, when 24h pass with 0 photos and zero-accepted-output-24h fires. NEEDS HUMAN: arbitrate labeler vs renders, or fund a lower-VRAM flux config.

2026-09-21 05:4xZ ops-triage: DECISION NEEDED -- starvation is the binding constraint and it is NOT fixable in-repo. Renders need a near-empty card (ComfyUI's measured peak on the 4090 is 23.2GiB of 24.0GiB; log/comfyui_telemetry.jsonl, job comfyui-1789826497-1334030, 372 samples, max 23743MiB), so ANY co-tenant holding more than the ~0.8GiB left over starves every render. Blocker: BT-Net's labeler (pid 2857312 labeler_spa.py, 4.6GiB, UI on :8085) -- RESIDENT BUT IDLE: card 0% busy across 5 samples over 10s, 0.3% CPU over its 6h46m life. Asks, cheapest first: (a) stop the labeler when not labeling -- 4.6GiB returns and renders resume on the next tick; (b) fund ONE measured render with a streaming launch (--lowvram) to learn whether renders can co-exist with a co-tenant at all; (c) accept no renders and drain the 18-post queue in ~4-6 days. Verified correct this pass, no action needed from us: the harness gives up the FIFO head instead of blocking smaller jobs, retires its entry as cancelled (comfyui-1789930863-2431031), and the scheduler is idle with an EMPTY derived queue -- no orphan, no off-lease launch, no claim held. Escalation: check_render_acceptance (critical zero-accepted-output-24h) fires 2026-09-21T16:00Z; last photo created 2026-09-20T16:00:34Z. Probe improvement this run: the refusal evidence now carries the measured peak vs card total and the utilization window, so this line no longer has to be re-derived by hand each tick.
